_about: Requirements-capture gauntlet — one place to see exactly what is being tested. Edit this file, then run it with: node gauntlets/run.mjs requirements-capture. Nothing about which arms, which tasks, how many iterations, or how fast is hidden in the runner. See README.md.

execution._mode: 'parallel' runs cells concurrently (faster, heavier on your API spend/rate limits). 'sequential' runs them one at a time (slower, gentler). Override with --mode.
execution._concurrency: How many cells run at once when mode is 'parallel'. Lower = gentler on rate limits and spend. Ignored when mode is 'sequential'. Override with --concurrency.
execution._iterations: Repeats per (arm, task) cell. Higher = less noise, more spend. Override with --iterations.
execution._models: Model ids as your endpoint serves them (e.g. gpt-4o, gemini-1.5-pro, or via a litellm proxy). author drives each requirements process; stakeholder answers only what is asked; auditor scores which hidden decisions the spec captured and records why. To compare processes fairly, vary --author-model and keep stakeholder/auditor fixed.

provider._endpoint: Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint. Set the URL here or via --base-url or $GAUNTLET_BASE_URL, and the key via $GAUNTLET_API_KEY (falls back to $OPENAI_API_KEY). Point it at OpenAI, Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Google, or a litellm proxy.

_run_label: Output goes to results/<run_label>/. Change it per run so results are not overwritten. Override with --run-label.
_arms: Each id maps to arms/<id>/arm.json (definition + provenance) and arms/<id>/process.md (the exact process text the author is given). Set enabled:false to skip an arm.
_tasks: Each id maps to tasks/<id>/task.json. To add your own task with different hidden requirements, copy tasks/loan-allocation, edit the files, and add its id here. See README.md > Adding a task.
